title: adhatoda betonica
intro: Adhatoda betonica, commonly known as Vasa, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, and treating fever. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda betonica include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-microbial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Adhatoda betonica include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
